Introduction.SourceString: 梦想是成为拯救世界的美少女高中生！
Introduction.LocalizedString: My dream is to become a beautiful high school girl who saves the world!

Content.SourceString:
哈尼娅，呗果公开账号@哈尼娅_斯特利速递，私人账号@盖罗塞克特女子学院超异科王牌一号，目前常用马甲小号@今天吃到新谷了吗。公开账号用来推销斯特利速递的服务，顺便经营一下斯特利速递「只要钱到位，什么都能送！」（九原语）的形象；私人账号则是哈尼娅的社交账号，文，画，音乐，正片……是圈内产出无数的超王太太，唯一的缺点就是更新极度不稳定，粉丝们经常一边哀嚎一边好吃好吃；至于马甲小号，在偷懒不想更新的日子里，哈尼娅就用着各种小号在呗果匿名冲浪，掉马就立刻转生下一个，立志维护吃粮自由。

或许你送过快递吗？斯特利速递的几位快递员都有自己的送货习惯，对于哈尼娅来说，当拿到快递单的那一刻，一份使命就交到了她的手上——
「今日任务：送快递（0/1）
快递完整度：100%
剩余时间：00:59:59
三星评价达成：
快递无伤（0/1)
时限送达（0/1）
微笑服务（0/1）」

哈尼娅小时候有很多「兴趣爱好」，小提琴，马术，象棋……就像她身边的同龄人一样，接受着传统的「精英教育」。哈尼娅并不讨厌这些，却也远远谈不上喜欢，就好像是湿哒哒的阴雨天，世界就像是被减淡了色彩，连羽毛都会粘黏在一起。
哈尼娅更喜欢晴天。于是，年幼的哈尼娅在睡前故事环节前，与母亲进行了一次平等的对话。她表达了自己的诉求与困惑，向最亲近的母亲寻求帮助，而妈妈轻柔地摸着哈尼娅的头发，因为自己的疏忽没能及时察觉到哈尼娅的心情向她道歉。
找到自己真正的「兴趣爱好」是很困难的，还好哈尼娅足够幸运。
Content.LocalizedString:
Haniel. Public Bagel Account: @Haniel_SterryExpress. Private Account: @genesectparanormaldeptace. Current main alt: @fancontentmaster. The public account is for plugging Sterry Express and managing the brand image of Sterry Express—"If the money's good, we deliver anything!" (Jiuyuan's words). The private account is Haniel's main social hub: fics, art, music, cosplay sets… In the scene, she's a god-tier creator with an endless output. Her only flaw? Her posting schedule is a disaster! Her fans live in permanent agony, screaming: "It's so good, I'll take whatever crumbs I can get!" As for the alt, on days she's too lazy to post, Haniel just surfs Bagel incognito on various throwaway accounts. The second her cover is blown, she jumps ship to the next. She's sworn to defend the sacred right to consume fan content in peace.

Ever delivered a package before? Every Sterry Express courier has their own delivery ritual. For Haniel, the moment she gets the delivery slip, it's like a quest notification has dropped straight into her hands——
Today's Quest: Deliver Package (0/1)
Package Integrity: 100%
Time Left: 00:59:59
3-Star Rating:
No-Damage Delivery (0/1)
On-Time Delivery (0/1)
Service with a Smile (0/1)

When Haniel was little, she had a ton of so-called "hobbies": violin, horseback riding, chess… Just like every other kid in her circle, she went through the usual "elite education" routine. She didn't hate any of it, but that didn't mean she liked it either. It all felt like a drizzly, soggy day where the world's colors are washed out and even birds feathers get stuck together.
Haniel likes sunny days better. So, before her nightly bedtime story, little Haniel sat down with her mother for a real conversation on equal footing. She laid out what she wanted and what confused her, asking the person closest to her for help. Her mom gently stroked her hair and apologized, saying she'd failed to notice Haniel's feelings in time.
Finding your true "hobby," the thing that's really yours, is hard. Luckily, Haniel was one of the fortunate ones.

Content.SourceString:
成为精英快递员的道路并非一帆风顺。
在第16次送货任务中，快递不甚丢失了。尽管在丢件三个小时后又被找了回来，九原店长也并未责怪什么，哈尼娅依旧感到很内疚。并不想让家人过多的担心，哈尼娅在餐桌上表现一如往常，随口聊着她感兴趣的各种话题。当然，勇敢的哈尼娅并不会被这种负面情绪困扰太久，睡一觉起来，哈尼娅又变成了往常的哈尼娅。只是出门前，哈尼娅收到了一份礼物，昨晚餐桌上作为话题开启的耳机，此时正静静地躺在她的房门口。
「哈尼娅一定会成为最棒的快递员。」礼物盒上这样写着。
Content.LocalizedString:
The path to becoming an Elite Courier isn't always smooth sailing.
During her 16th delivery quest, Haniel accidentally lost a package. Even though it was found three hours later and Owner Jiuyuan didn't blame her for anything, Haniel still felt really guilty. Not wanting to worry her family too much, Haniel acted normal at the dinner table, casually chatting about all sorts of topics she was interested in. Of course, brave Haniel wouldn't let negative feelings bother her for long. After a good night's sleep, she was back to her usual self… but before leaving the house, Haniel received a gift. The headset she had mentioned at dinner the night before was now sitting quietly by her bedroom door.
"Haniel will definitely become the best courier ever," read the note on the gift box.

Content.SourceString:
泛黄的贴纸和稚嫩的字迹，这是哈尼娅藏在书柜最深处的秘密。
「皇家的鹰犬不过是我的坐骑，十分钟之后你的罪行必将暴露无遗。」
「为了胜利赌上一切的人，才有资格站在赛场上！」
「连希望和梦想都没有的混蛋，我可是肉体毁灭前都会挺直腰杆活下去的！」
「目的地根本不重要，只要继续前进，只要不停下脚步……」
「我的复仇，从这里才拉开帷幕。」
——毕竟谁没有一本塞满童年回忆的摘抄本呢。
Content.LocalizedString:
Yellowed stickers and childish handwriting… this is the secret Haniel has hidden in the deepest part of her bookshelf.
"The royal hounds are nothing but my steeds. In ten minutes, your crimes will be exposed!"
"Only those who risk everything for victory have the right to stand on the battlefield!"
"You bastards without hope or dreams, I'll keep my back straight and live on until my body is destroyed!"
"The destination doesn't matter at all, as long as I keep moving forward, as long as I don't stop…"
"My revenge… this is where the curtain truly rises."
After all, who doesn't have a notebook stuffed full of childhood memories?

Content.SourceString:
在熬夜追完《未来的音符》后，凌晨三点四十三分，哈尼娅顶着哭红的双眼下单了一把吉他。这一次，乐队的结局交由她来改写！
很可惜的是「精英教育」有小提琴，中提琴，大提琴，但没有教过哈尼娅怎么弹吉他。这一切都没有关系，勇敢哈尼娅，不怕困难！
想象一下：放学后，和风拂过鬓角的碎发，一个人骑着自行车来到夕阳下的公园，在喷泉旁，忧郁胆怯的少女终于寻到了一个无人注意的安静角落。她深呼吸一口，拿出了一把来自父亲的吉他，拨片轻轻抚过琴弦，动听的乐曲在少女的指间流淌，树叶落在水面上，而在演奏完成后，另一个少女从一旁的树丛里跳出来，双眼冒星星说：「你可以和我一起组乐队吗？」
于是，哈尼娅带着吉他在公园坐了整整三个月，唯一的听众只有小猫……小猫观众，那也很好。
Content.LocalizedString:
After finishing binge-watching "Notes of the Future" at 3:43 AM, Haniel ordered a guitar while her eyes were still red from crying. This time, she would rewrite the band's ending herself.
Unfortunately, her elite education included violin, viola, and cello, but she had never been taught how to play guitar. None of that mattered though. Brave Haniel wasn't afraid of any challenge!
Picture this: After school, Haniel rides her bike alone to the park at sunset, a gentle breeze brushing the loose strands by her temples. By the fountain, the sentimental, shy girl finally finds a quiet corner where no one will notice. She takes a deep breath and pulls out a guitar she got from her father, the pick gently caressing the strings as beautiful melodies flow from the girl's fingertips. Leaves fall onto the water's surface, and when the performance ends, another girl jumps out from the nearby bushes with stars in her eyes, saying "Would you like to start a band with me?"
So Haniel sat in the park with her guitar for three whole months, with only cats as her audience… though cat audiences are pretty good too.

Title.SourceString: 一张沾有辣油的便签纸
Title.LocalizedString: Sticky Note with Chili Oil Stains

Content.SourceString:
如何泡一杯完美的红茶：
事前的材料准备：茶叶，选取OP级茶叶，非袋泡装；软水，矿物质水不可；新鲜的低温灭菌奶；些许白砂糖，一套足够优雅的茶具。
步骤：1.煮水，将软水煮沸
2.温壶，一分钟即可
3.投茶比（一杯一茶匙茶叶）
4.茶叶闷泡三分钟
5.最好用陶瓷制的杯子喝茶
6.往杯中先加牛奶，然后缓缓倒茶
7.砂糖随个人喜好添加
8.饮用红茶的温度最好控制在60~65度之间
###切记：先奶后茶
一行潦草的字迹：先茶后奶也很好喝
Content.LocalizedString:
How to Brew the Perfect Cup of Black Tea:
Materials needed: Tea leaves (select OP-grade loose leaf, not tea bags), soft water (no mineral water), fresh pasteurized milk, a bit of white sugar, and an elegant tea set.
Steps: 1. Boil water, bring the soft water to a boil
2. Warm the pot for one minute
3. Ration the tea leaves (one teaspoon of tea leaves per cup)
4. Steep the tea leaves for three minutes
5. It's best to drink tea from ceramic cups
6. Add the milk to the cup first, then slowly pour in the tea
7. Add sugar according to personal preference
8. The best drinking temperature is between 60–65 degrees Celsius
### Remember: Milk first, then tea
A line of messy handwriting: Tea first then milk tastes good too

Content.SourceString:
哈尼娅的书中总是夹杂着很多的书签，每一个上面都印有不同的小动物爪印。每当哈尼娅成功和公园里的小动物们成为朋友，哈尼娅就会专门为它制作一枚书签，印上它的爪印留作纪念。毕竟这些小旅者们的脚步总在路上，下一次相遇就不知道会在何时。
哈尼娅的书中总是夹着一张有些旧了的书签，印着一个黑色的，不太完整的小猫爪印，黑白色的书签，和它的花纹一样。哈尼娅并没有和它成为朋友，那是一只过于警惕的小猫。在其他猫猫们欢快地分享哈尼娅带来的零食时，它总是在远处静静地看着。
现在，它依旧静静地睡在小山坡上，哈尼娅偶尔会去弹吉他，虽然很难听。
Content.LocalizedString:
Haniel's books are always filled with bookmarks, each stamped with little animal paw prints. Whenever Haniel befriends small animals in the park, she makes a special bookmark for them, stamping their paws as keepsakes. These little travelers are always on the move. Who knows when they'll meet again?
There's always one slightly worn bookmark in Haniel's books. It’s stamped with a black, somewhat incomplete kitten paw print, and the markings match the black and white bookmark. Haniel never became friends with this one… the cat was far too cautious. While the other cats happily shared the snacks Haniel brought, this one would always watch quietly from a distance.
It still sleeps peacefully on the same little hillside. Haniel sometimes goes there to play guitar, even though she sounds terrible.

Content.SourceString: 你好呀，我是哈尼娅·克雷斯维尔，叫我哈尼娅就好。有什么需要就喊我的名字吧，我以「动感小耳朵」的名字起誓，只要是你的呼唤，我绝对会听到的！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey there! I'm Haniel Cresswell, but you can just call me Haniel. If you need anything, shout my name! I swear on the name of "E.A.R"—if it's your voice, I'll always hear it!

Content.SourceString: 闹钟，确定！网速，确定！这次绝对能抢到限量版！
Content.LocalizedString: Alarm—check! Wi-Fi—check! This time I'm definitely getting that limited drop!

Content.SourceString: 哈呼以！修拉呼啦！人间完全放电、激爆冲击波的极嗨发射器，吾以哈尼娅之名命令你，现！
Content.LocalizedString: Hahuie! Shulahula! Supercharged Shockwave Ultra Blaster—by the name of Haniel, I summon you!

Content.SourceString: 周末看望小猫们的时候，带上些新口味的猫罐头吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Gotta bring some new flavors of cat food when I visit the kittens this weekend.

Content.SourceString: 太阳真好啊，无论是睡大觉还是做什么都很适合。
Content.LocalizedString: Such a nice sunny day. Perfect for a nap… or just about anything.

Content.SourceString: 来一首舒缓的音乐如何？……唔，希望耳机不要进水。
Content.LocalizedString: How about some chill beats? Ugh, hope the headphones don't short again.

Content.SourceString: 好冷好冷好冷这个时候最适合吃火锅了吧！要超级加倍辣！
Content.LocalizedString: It's freezing! Time for hotpot! Extra spicy, of course!

Content.SourceString: 静心，静心，静心……呼，哈尼娅第七十二次静心修行失败。
Content.LocalizedString: Calm, calm, calm… Phew… Haniel's 72nd attempt at meditation… failed.

Content.SourceString: 早上好，新的一天开始了！
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning! A brand new day starts now!

Content.SourceString: 中午好，想好午餐吃什么了吗？要不要听听我的推荐？
Content.LocalizedString: Afternoon! Got lunch plans? Want a rec?

Content.SourceString: 晚上好，我正打算出去散步，要一起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Evening! I'm heading out for a stroll. Wanna come?

Content.SourceString: 深夜是最适合补番的了，放心不会很晚的，看完这集就睡！大概……
Content.LocalizedString: Late night's the best time to catch up on anime. Don't worry, just one episode before bed! Probably…

Content.SourceString: 目标是集齐所有的联名款耳机！新款倒是可以零点秒杀，一些古早款只能在二手市场慢慢蹲守了。从音质上来说，就算是用心保养的老式耳机也比不上便宜很多的新款，但是古早OST就应该用古早耳机听嘛，混杂着底噪的音乐也很有味道呢，有空的话，给你看看我的收藏。
Content.LocalizedString: My goal? Collect every limited-edition collab headset! The new ones I can snag at launch, but for vintage ones, it's all about patience. Sure, even the best-kept old headsets can't beat cheap modern ones in sound quality—but classic OSTs deserve that analog crackle. I'll show you my collection sometime.

Content.SourceString: 烦恼……好像说不上有什么大烦恼，小烦恼的话，很难写的作业，吵吵的伊里卡，送货时模糊的地址和吹毛求疵的客人……其实都算不上什么啦，吃一顿饱饱的晚饭再睡个好觉，第二天的哈尼娅就满血复活了！
Content.LocalizedString: Big worries? Not really. Small ones? Tough homework, noisy Illica, vague delivery addresses, picky customers… nothing a good meal and sleep can't fix. Haniel's always back at full power the next day!

Content.SourceString: 听老人家说，很早的时候人类和异象还有异能者之间的关系很不稳定，经常会发生冲突……不过等到我出生的时候，异象就像是家人，宠物，帮手，虽然有时候还是避免不了矛盾，但是绝大多数异象都是很可爱的！
Content.LocalizedString: The elders said there was a time when humans, Espers, and anomalies were always at odds. But by the time I was born, anomalies felt more like family—pets, even. Sure, not everything's perfect, but most anomalies are super cute!

Content.SourceString: 刀子和叉子不能换着拿，喝汤不能发出声音，如果连享受美食都要规规矩矩的话那也太痛苦了吧！就像辣条这种食物，放在鎏金瓷盘中，配上刀叉和小提琴……也不会比拿在手里吃更香。
Content.LocalizedString: Knives on the left, forks on the right, and no slurping your soup? If you can't enjoy food freely, what's the point? Like spicy sticks—put 'em on a gilded plate with violin music… still won't beat eating 'em straight from the bag.

Content.SourceString: 人和人之间的交往真的很奇妙呢，只是出于对同一个角色的喜爱，很快就可以变成无话不谈的好朋友，一些无法对现实中的亲人朋友说出的话，却可以很轻松地对着网络上的同好们袒露。我也有一位很好很好的朋友，不知道有没有机会在线下见面，真期待啊。
Content.LocalizedString: It's wild how people connect—just sharing love for a character can make two strangers close friends. There are things I can't even tell my real-life friends that I'll share with someone online in a heartbeat. I've got one really special online friend… I hope we meet offline someday.

Content.SourceString: 追连载最大的痛苦就是看到休刊通知了，恨不得把作者关进小黑屋里一直写到完结，但是轮到自己就……嘿嘿，马甲的存在就是在不想更新的日子里大口吃粮，而且不是不想更新，我这是在找灵感！
Content.LocalizedString: The worst thing about following a series? Hiatus notices. You want to lock the author in a room till they finish! But then when it's my turn to write… heh. That's what alt accounts are for! I'm not skipping updates—I'm… looking for inspiration!

Content.SourceString: 小时候我很羡慕异能者，就像动漫里主角总是身负奇遇拯救世界，但真的轮到我的那一刻我才明白，比起成为主角，我更想要的是能够守护大家的能力，如果当时我再厉害一点，或许它现在就能和别的小猫一样健康长大了吧……我说这些可不是为了让你难过的。有空的时候我们一起去看看它吧，那是一个风景很不错的地方呢。
Content.LocalizedString: I used to envy Espers. Like the heroes in anime—chosen ones, saving the world. But when it was my turn, I realized: I don't want to be the protagonist. I want the power to protect others. If I'd been a little stronger back then… maybe it would've survived like the other kittens. But I'm not telling you this to make you sad. Let's go visit together sometime. It's a really pretty place.

Content.SourceString: 「有些鸟儿适合在笼中生活，精致的食水会让他们的羽毛更加蓬松美丽，但有些鸟儿是关不住的，他们的羽翼只会在自由的天空下闪耀。」对我来说，我想要温暖的家，也想要自由飞翔，虽然听起来有点贪心，但是我很满意现在的生活。
Content.LocalizedString: "Some birds are meant for cages—their feathers fluff up from fine feed and water. But some birds can't be caged. Their wings only shine in the open sky." Me? I want a warm home and freedom. Maybe that's greedy, but I'm happy with my life.

Content.SourceString: 斯特利速递的工作既不耽误上课，还有金钱的召唤和拯救世界的使命！九原姐发工资也超级大方，太快乐了！为了不辜负九原姐的信赖，我，哈尼娅，绝对会成为斯特利速递最棒的快递员！就是希望九原姐少生气，生气很容易长皱纹什么的……咳咳。
Content.LocalizedString: Working at Sterry Express doesn't get in the way of school, pays well, and comes with a world-saving mission! Jiuyuan's also super generous with bonuses—what's not to love? I, Haniel, will become Sterry's top courier! If only Jiuyuan wouldn't get so mad—stress causes wrinkles, y'know… cough.

Content.SourceString: 第一次见到简森哥的时候，我觉得他超——酷——！就像番剧中的靠谱成年人，无论我有什么问题，他全都答得上来！我觉得简森哥一定还有什么特殊身份，绝对不只是一个普普通通的送货店老板，嗯，番剧中都是这么写的。
Content.LocalizedString: The first time I met Jenson, I thought—"Wow, this guy is so cool!" Like a dependable anime adult! Ask him anything, he's got an answer! No way he's just a normal shopkeep—bet he's hiding some secret identity. That's how it goes in shows!

Content.SourceString: 吵吵的呆头鸟！……早知道会在斯特利速递又见到他，毕业的时候就不应该在同学录上写那么多字了。不过他当时也给我写了很多离别留言，还特地送了我想要很久的耳机作为毕业礼物，看着这些份上，暂时就不跟他计较了。
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, that noisy Silly! If I'd known we'd reunite at Sterry, I wouldn't have written so much in his yearbook… But hey, he wrote a bunch in mine too. Even gave me a headset I'd wanted for ages as a grad gift. So… I'll let it slide.

Content.SourceString: 我好想试试哈索尔的摩托车，开起来一定很爽吧！嗯……虽然很多客人都说哈索尔看起来冷冰冰的，只是因为他们没有和哈索尔相处过。而且只要有我在，异能失控什么的全都是小问题！勇敢哈尼娅，不怕困难！
Content.LocalizedString: I really wanna try Hathor's motorcycle. Must feel amazing to ride! People say she seems cold—but that's only 'cause they don't know her. With me around, even Esper Ability blowups are no big deal! Go Haniel! No fear!

Content.SourceString: 因为救下了被异能反噬的哈索尔，被九原姐引荐进入了斯特利速递，认识了老板简森哥，然后又跟伊里卡重逢……这一切，简直可以拍一部「哈尼娅传奇」了……不对不对「斯特利群侠传」或者「假面快递员」怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: I saved Hathor when her Esper powers backfired. Jiuyuan brought me into Sterry after that. Then I met Jenson, and Illica showed up again… It's like the start of "The Haniel Chronicles"… no, wait, maybe "Courier X Stelry"? "Masked Courier"? We'll work on it.

Content.SourceString: 隐秘在落魄街道的神秘古董店VS藏匿于人群之中普通却并不普通的快递公司，这一集绝对值得一个剧场版！
Content.LocalizedString: Hidden relic shop on a shady street vs. undercover express company in plain sight—this arc needs a movie adaptation!

Content.SourceString: 这就是……力量吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So THIS is… power?

Content.SourceString: 准备好拯救世界了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Ready to save the world?

Content.SourceString: 羽毛变得更好看了！
Content.LocalizedString: My feathers look nicer now!

Content.SourceString: 嘘快听……听见到了吗？哈尼娅好感度加一加一加一！
Content.LocalizedString: Psst, do you hear that…? Haniel's affection, up, up, up!

Content.SourceString: 哇！你怎么知道我喜欢这个！难道鉴定师还能鉴别喜好吗？好酷！
Content.LocalizedString: Wow, how did you know I liked this? Can you appraise preferences too? So cool!

Content.SourceString: 给我的吗？给我的吗！谢谢谢谢谢谢谢谢！
Content.LocalizedString: Is this for me? Thanks, thanks, thanks, thanks, thanks!

Content.SourceString: 下次接到伊波恩的单子我偷偷给你加急！
Content.LocalizedString: Next time when I get a request from Eibon, I'll mark it urgent for free!

Content.SourceString: 猫头音冲击波！
Content.LocalizedString: Whoots wave!

Content.SourceString: 来点变奏？
Content.LocalizedString: How about some variation?

Content.SourceString: 别那么无趣嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't be such a bore!

Content.SourceString: 该听我的音乐了！
Content.LocalizedString: My turn!

Content.SourceString: 接下来是我的主场！
Content.LocalizedString: Now it's my time to shine!

Content.SourceString: 伴奏就交给我吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Leave the accompaniment to me!

Content.SourceString: 打卡！今日份的工作也……呃……顺利完成。
Content.LocalizedString: Punch out! Another job smoo… uhh… smoothly done!

Content.SourceString: 放心，我的打包技术一流……呜呃……没事没事。
Content.LocalizedString: No worries! My packing skills are top-notch… Wugh… it's fine, n-nothing's wrong.

Content.SourceString: 记得五星好评哟。
Content.LocalizedString: Remember to give a five-star review!

Content.SourceString: 收工收工。
Content.LocalizedString: That's a wrap!

Content.SourceString: 这个就不用签收了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: This doesn't need to be signed for, right?

Content.SourceString: 哦？是隐藏奖励吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh? A hidden reward?

Content.SourceString: 这样的好运可以延续到下次抽赏吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can this luck carry over to my next gacha pull?

Content.SourceString: 快看看有什么好东西？
Content.LocalizedString: Let's see what goodies we've got!

Content.SourceString: 唔~值得发条呗果庆祝一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Mmm! This deserves a celebratory Bagel post!

Content.SourceString: 我就知道今天运气不错！
Content.LocalizedString: I knew I'd be lucky today!

Content.SourceString: 好累啊……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm so tired…

Content.SourceString: 电量不足……
Content.LocalizedString: Battery running low…

Content.SourceString: 急需补给点！
Content.LocalizedString: Need a supply drop ASAP!

Content.SourceString: 状态满分！
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect condition!

Content.SourceString: 无敌的哈尼娅又回来了！
Content.LocalizedString: The invincible Haniel is back!

Content.SourceString: 结局不该是这样……
Content.LocalizedString: It's not supposed to end like this…

Content.SourceString: 能申请二周目吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Can I get a New Game Plus…

Content.SourceString: 对不起，靠你们了……
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, it's up to y'all now…

Content.SourceString: 轻轻松松嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: Piece of cake!

Content.SourceString: 这就是王牌的实力。
Content.LocalizedString: Behold the power of the ace!

Content.SourceString: 哎呦。
Content.LocalizedString: Ouch!

Content.SourceString: 小失误。
Content.LocalizedString: Minor slip-up!

Content.SourceString: 好痛。
Content.LocalizedString: That hurts!

Content.SourceString: 快递没坏吧？
Content.LocalizedString: The package isn't damaged, is it?

Content.SourceString: 精英快递员的出场费可不低哦。
Content.LocalizedString: It's expensive to hire an Elite Courier, you know!

Content.SourceString: 我听到了有人在呼唤「哈尼娅」之名。
Content.LocalizedString: I hear someone yearning for Haniel!

Content.SourceString: 满分投掷！
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect throw!

Content.SourceString: 你在看哪？
Content.LocalizedString: Where are you looking at?

Content.SourceString: 三振出局！
Content.LocalizedString: Strike three, you're out!

Content.SourceString: 呜呼！呼哈！风起！
Content.LocalizedString: Whoosh! Hyah! Rise!

Content.SourceString: 准备准备！要一个帅气的落地！
Content.LocalizedString: Get ready! Time for a stunning entrance!

Content.SourceString: 主角救场时间！
Content.LocalizedString: Ready to save the day!

Content.SourceString: 该换个节奏了！
Content.LocalizedString: Time to switch up the beat!

Content.SourceString: 你的呼唤，我听到了哦！
Content.LocalizedString: I heard your calling!

Content.SourceString: 九原姐！交给我吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Jiuyuan! Leave it to me!

Content.SourceString: 哈索尔！该换班啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Hathor! Time for my shift!

Content.SourceString: 来合奏吧！音浪猛虎！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's rock! Roaring Tiger!

Content.SourceString: 竟然敢欺负九原姐！
Content.LocalizedString: How dare you bully Jiuyuan!

Content.SourceString: 哈索尔！不要一个人逞强啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Hathor! Don't try to tough it out alone!

Content.SourceString: 可不能在这种时候倒下啊！
Content.LocalizedString: We can't fall at a time like this!

Content.SourceString: 音游可是我的强项！
Content.LocalizedString: Rhythm games are my specialty!

Content.SourceString: 抓住节奏！
Content.LocalizedString: Catch the beat!

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，我的闪避可是点满了！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, I maxed out my dodge stat!

Content.SourceString: 啧啧，太慢了哦？
Content.LocalizedString: Uh-uh, too slow!
